messages:
maria: FYI canary for web-frontend@v2.3.1 blocked by provenance check during RC, deploy-bot says missing base image digest. Can we triage quickly?

deploy-bot: Deployment web-frontend@v2.3.1 -> canary(20) STATUS: blocked. Gate: SBOM provenance: base_image_digest not pinned. See /artifacts/web-frontend/2.3.1/sbom.json

raj: ack, looking. This is likely a build pipeline change that left :latest tag in the image. Quick fix is to pin the FROM line to the digest and cut v2.3.1.1.

denise: how bad is impact to users if we pause canary? Canary traffic is small but it's blocking the RC. Do we have a fast path or need sec approval?

maria: canary currently 0/20 rolled out, no user-facing errors observed yet. Prefer minimal blast radius patch and re-run canary.

raj: patch suggestion (in CI Dockerfile):
```
FROM gcr.io/redwood-images/web-base@sha256:abc123def456...
# rebuild, push, tag v2.3.1.1
```
I'll push a branch with the change now.

sec-approvals-bot: Manual security approval required: SBOM provenance mismatch -> base image digest missing. Approvers: katherine-sec or sec-team oncall. Please respond with /approve or give exception rationale.

tony-sre: Recommending pin + re-run canary. Rollback not needed, not yet in prod. If approval delayed >15m we can hold RC window but I'd prefer patching.

katherine-sec: Reviewing patch branch. Quick question: does pinning the base image digest change licensing or introduce transitive dependency changes? I need SBOM diff to be sure.

raj: SBOM diff is tiny — only base image digest added. No new packages. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/web-frontend/pull/482 (CI built artifact at gcr.io/redwood-images/web-frontend:2.3.1.1)

maria: katherine can you /approve when ready? The release window is in 45m.

katherine-sec: /approve - provenance verified, SBOM diff acceptable. Please ensure release notes mention the base image pin in case of audits. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Approval recorded by katherine-sec. Resuming canary for web-frontend@v2.3.1.1 -> canary(20).

maria: rolling. Thanks all. tagging release notes: "Pinned base image digest to satisfy SBOM provenance gate; no functional changes."

denise: :thumbsup: good call on patching vs rollback. Keep me posted if canary shows anomalies.

tony-sre: monitoring dashboards set for next 30m, alert at +2x error rate.

maria: closing thread when canary hits 100% or we abort.
